content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 12 (¶p0086) warrants the Software will conform to the Specifications for the acceptance period plus one year — comfortably clearing the fallback 90-day software conformance element. But nothing warrants Garman's services (installation, training, Maintenance Services), and there is no warranty remedy: the Section 8(b) return of amounts paid applies only on rejection during acceptance testing, and the Section 10(c) Software Repair Service is a best-efforts maintenance duty subject to chargeable exclusions, not a warranty remedy. No disclaimer exists, so this is not walk-away.

**Classification:** deviation — fails fallback on the services warranty and the refund remedy.

**Cure (fallback, one insertion after ¶p0086):** a 30-day professional-and-workmanlike services warranty plus a repair/replace-or-refund remedy for breach of Section 12, leaving the existing software warranty period and all other text verbatim.
